headline: Multiple growth drivers

highlights: US revenues improved both QoQ and YoY on the back of integration of Lannett portfolio during the quarter.
We believe ARBP has multiple growth drivers in place with investments in vaccines, injectables, biosimilars and PLI which are expected to be reflected from FY27E/FY28E.
We retain our “Hold” rating with revised TP of INR 1,775/share; valuing at 18x Sept’28E EPS. • Higher EU & US revenues YoY: Overall Revenue came in at INR 102.6bn, up 24% YoY, (we est INR 97bn).
US revenues stood at USD 476mn, up 20% QoQ and 14% YoY (we est USD 460mn).

We believe ARBP has multiple growth drivers in place with investments in vaccines, injectables, biosimilars and PLI which are expected to be reflected from FY27E/FY28E.
US:RoW mix has shifted from 70:30 to 55:45, with management targeting 50:50 by FY28–29.
watch: In near term ramp up in PenG facility, Vizag pant commercialization will be key.

Respiratory remains a key growth driver, with one partnered inhalation product launched, an in-house MDI approved for launch and 4 additional products under development. • Eugia/injectables: Eugia continued to deliver double-digit growth, with plants operating at full capacity.
